# Prism 1.30.0

Unmodified minified core and C-like, JavaScript, and TypeScript grammars from
the [`prismjs` npm package](https://registry.npmjs.org/prismjs/-/prismjs-1.30.0.tgz).
Prism is [MIT licensed](LICENSE).

Only these components are bundled into the landing page. The page supplies its
own colors and calls the highlighter explicitly; no CDN or plugins are needed.
